notes: Too fast over the hill! The track would have to PULL the object down to keep it on the curve (N < 0), so it flies through the air and bumps back down, losing energy. Real roller coasters have wheels under the rail to stop this.
A rolling ball spins as well as moves: 29% of its motion energy goes into spinning, so it is slower than a sliding box (v = sqrt(2gh/(1+k))).
